name: WebSpeak
title: WebSpeak

description.en: Self-hosted browser client and voice gateway for TeamSpeak 3 and TeamSpeak 6
description.zh: 可自行部署的 TeamSpeak 3 和 TeamSpeak 6 网页客户端与语音网关

zh.introduction: 是可自行部署的 TeamSpeak 3 和 TeamSpeak 6 网页客户端与语音网关。访客可以通过浏览器加入频道，管理员可以管理目标服务器和访问策略。

features.title: 浏览器语音
features.description: 支持 Opus 语音和可选的 WebRTC 低延迟传输。

features.title: 管理控制台
features.description: 管理服务器、访问策略、邀请链接和运行状态。

en.introduction: is a self-hosted browser client and voice gateway for TeamSpeak 3 and TeamSpeak 6. Visitors can join channels in a browser, while administrators manage target servers and access policy.

features.title: Browser voice
features.description: Supports Opus audio and optional low-latency WebRTC transport.

features.title: Administration
features.description: Manage servers, access policy, invite links, and runtime state.

notes: The 1Panel bridge-network package maps the default WebRTC UDP range 40000-40099. Keep the admin-console range aligned with the Compose mapping.
The local package references the fork's GHCR image, not the upstream image. The image is published by docker-publish.yml after CI succeeds.
For a TeamSpeak server on the same host, use host.docker.internal or a reachable host address as its target.
